records.label: Use official classification and evidence first
records.details: Use NAPCS as classification, CCMC/ICC-ES/UL/ENERGY STAR/NRCan as evidence layers before live retail pricing.

records.label: Create product class templates
records.details: Create class templates for lumber, insulation, windows, doors, roofing, fasteners, plumbing, electrical, tools and HVAC.

records.label: Use retailer APIs/portals where available
records.details: Lowe's has a Product Catalog API; Home Depot public catalog access appears supplier/third-party only; RONA/Home Hardware are mostly supplier docs/public browsing.

records.label: Use paid scraping APIs carefully
records.details: SerpApi and Unwrangle can pull Home Depot/Lowe's product pages when official APIs are unavailable.

records.label: Convert manufacturer catalog/spec pages
records.details: ARCAT, Sweets and BIM platforms can supply catalogs, BIM/CAD and specification pages; convert by manufacturer/category.
